postProcessingDocumentation: Disabling post-processing forgoes color correctness as well as some anti-aliasing techniques. It also includes bloom, color grading and gamma encoding.
hdrPortabilityConcern: AssetLoader1493 multiplies emissiveFactor by strength;1678 sets strength separately; base.mat.in138 multiplies both. Actual Ubershader execution not yet measured; do not promote HDR extension candidate based on Blender alone.
